name: Akita (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with a white ring enclosing a lattice mark — the character 田 stylised.
history: The flag of Akita bears the city's mon (municipal emblem) in the Japanese civic tradition of a single stylised mark on a plain field.

features.role: Akita municipal emblem — a white ring enclosing a lattice mark — the character 田 stylised
features.symbolism: a rebus on the city's name: サ over 田 (ta)
